<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Quota policy:</strong> The government informed the Supreme Court that the exclusion of the &quot;creamy layer&quot; from SC/ST quotas is a matter for Parliament to decide, maintaining that such exclusions cannot be unilaterally applied.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative business:</strong> Parliament has passed bills authorizing the appropriation of funds for excess expenditure and specific government demands, while the Lok Sabha prepares to debate the MSME Development (Amendment) Bill and legislation concerning Kashmiri Pandits.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxONk94S1ZjY0pBR1NaZEdUVGNTVFIwZXZoSF9rSmw4X3ZGTlpGUmw4Nk1pVFdWVUdWakFxdzkzZ250Z2w5cDVSeGVJZVpsUGpkOTFOcUtjdkJ4YWtxcXJoRkU1NTYxMzRxSGR3UnFNTm5DV2ZUQ296d0lVOWtuRk9Gd0dLNmhjcm94Ymlhai1HV1hQMldyajR4enhLbGZYWVhjc3FydnQxNGhPMFFMLUlxZzc2Z0dpZjFYbmc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
